themes.description: Feedback related to advertising, promotional content, or marketing practices.
This theme covers complaints or feedback related to the quality, relevance, or intrusiveness of advertisements within the app or service.
This theme covers feedback related to app security, data protection, and user account safety.
This theme includes feedback on the overall platform experience, ease of use, available features, and specific offerings like account types.
Covers general user satisfaction, ease of use, and overall positive feedback about the application.
Addresses user concerns about the app's legitimacy, potential scams, or fraudulent activities.
Covers user suggestions or comparisons regarding competitive pricing structures and brokerage rates.
This theme covers problems related to account creation, activation, verification, or initial setup that prevent users from starting to use the service.
This theme covers issues related to incorrect, outdated, or misleading financial data displayed within the application, such as expense ratios, NAVs, or other investment parameters.
This theme covers feedback related to the availability, functionality, and enhancement of specific trading tools and features like stop-loss, target orders, or advanced order types.
This theme covers feedback related to the overall usability, design, navigation, and aesthetic appeal of the application or platform.
This theme covers issues related to app updates, installation, and general maintenance requirements. It addresses user frustration with frequent or mandatory updates.
This theme covers requests for new features, enhancements to existing functionalities, and user interface/experience improvements.
This theme covers issues related to the availability of specific investment products, funds, or financial instruments within the platform.
This theme covers issues related to logging in, account recovery, changing registered details, and general access to the user's account.
Reviews expressing satisfaction, praise for features, or general positive experiences with the application.
This theme covers complaints about intrusive, irrelevant, or disruptive advertisements within the app or related to its promotion.
This theme covers complaints about hidden data, lack of transparency in transactions, and issues with the visibility or accuracy of financial records like credits and profits.
This theme covers issues related to account creation, modification, deletion, KYC, or other administrative tasks concerning a user's account.
Requests for new functionalities, enhancements to existing features, or complaints about missing options within the platform.
Concerns related to data collection, app tracking, privacy policies, and transparency regarding user data.
Problems related to account creation, login, verification, or general account management.
Reviews related to advertisements, promotional content, or marketing communications.
Covers issues where the app is intrusive, such as unwanted notifications, persistent pop-ups, or unsolicited re-installations.
Suggestions for new features, enhancements to existing functionality, or missing tools within the application.
Covers requests and feedback regarding tools and features for investment analysis and research within the platform.
Issues related to missing or broken core features, general usability, and overall app design.
Concerns about trading rules, auto square-offs, price manipulation, or perceived unfair trading practices by the platform.
Issues related to how the platform handles corporate actions like demergers, splits, and bonuses, affecting portfolio display or financial calculations.
Reviews that are primarily questions about app features, compatibility, or general information rather than complaints about specific issues.
